other_failure_modes.name: Feature leakage from test set
other_failure_modes.description: The agent calculates aggregated statistics (e.g., value counts, group means) on the combined train and test dataset before splitting. This leaks the distribution and characteristics of the test set into the training features, leading to overly optimistic evaluation and potential overfitting.

summary: The agent implements a solid LightGBM pipeline with extensive feature engineering, including out-of-fold target encoding, cross-validation, and well-structured categorical handling. However, the agent computes several feature aggregations (value counts, group means) on the combined train and test dataset, leaking test set distributions into the training data. Additionally, the agent only evaluates the model using RMSE, ignoring other potentially relevant metrics.
